records.localization_note: Hodram Bergstrom is the nameplate; Sera calls him by his given name and the trader addresses him as admiral.
Gerhard Adernkatz recognizes Nagarpur and gives his own appraisal of the company.
Al Shin reacts to the insulting offer of a tip without an added shipboard title.
Charles Rochefort interprets Nagarpur's boast for the other crew members.
Fernando Dias distinguishes enjoying money from treating it as everything.
Sera Shahrbaraz uses the established nameplate while her fluency develops through the exchanges.
Zamorin Nagarpur is the established displayed form. The escort uses Nagarpur in the procession.
Trader fits the occupational label for the giver of the item in the opening of the legend exchange.
Sailor is the role label for the voice clearing the road for Nagarpur's party.
